_comment: Native Anthropic Messages. Stable prefixes carry prompt-cache breakpoints, PDFs ride as document blocks, and sampling parameters are not sent while thinking is active (protocol default). Models without sampling drop it always; adaptive-only Models cannot disable thinking, so off sends nothing.

rules.note: The catalog marks Models whose API removed sampling parameters; they are never sent.
These adaptive-only Models reject thinking type disabled, so the Agent effort none sends no thinking field.
